Title: Public preview: Azure Log Analytics is available in new regions in Australia

Body.Content: Azure Log Analytics is part of Azure Monitor. It collects telemetry from a variety of sources and uses the query language from Azure Data Explorer to retrieve and analyze data. Azure Log Analytics is available for preview now in Australia East and in Australia Central.
